title: SimHost operations
description: The methods GDScript calls on SimHost. Commands queue a press for the next tick, except saving, loading and the clock controls, which act at once.

entities.name: Queue a press
entities.description: Queues a press without an argument by name: start, launch, hyperspace, galaxy_drive, the queued flight actions, pause, resume, quit and the two toggles.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).
entities.result: true when queued for the next tick.
failures: false for an unknown name; nothing is queued.

entities.name: Choose the active mount
entities.description: Queues a mount choice, 0 fore to 3 starboard.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).

entities.name: Show a screen
entities.description: Queues showing a screen by name.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).
failures: false for an unknown screen name.

entities.name: Move the chart cursor
entities.description: Queues putting the chart cursor on a point, which selects the nearest system.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).
entities.result: Queued; the point is clamped to 0..255.

entities.name: Buy goods
entities.description: Queues buying a quantity of a goods item.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).
entities.result: Queued; the outcome arrives as the bought event.
failures: An item outside 0..16 is dropped; the quantity is clamped to 0..255.

entities.name: Sell goods
entities.description: Queues selling a quantity of a goods item.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).
entities.result: Queued; the outcome arrives as the sold event.

entities.name: Buy equipment
entities.description: Queues buying an equipment item, with a mount for a laser.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).
entities.result: Queued; the outcome arrives as the equipped event.
failures: An unknown item is dropped; a mount outside 0..3 means none.

entities.name: Save the pilot
entities.description: Saves the playing pilot under a name at once, to user://pilots.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).

entities.name: Load a pilot
entities.description: Loads a pilot by name at once (empty: the last saved one).
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).

entities.name: List saved pilots
entities.description: The names that have a record, sorted.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).

entities.name: Stop or start the clock
entities.description: Stops or restarts the real-time clock so a script can drive the sim.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).
entities.result: While stopped, frames run no ticks.

entities.name: Run ticks now
entities.description: Runs n ticks at once with the held actions as they are.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).
entities.result: n ticks run; their signals are emitted.

entities.name: Read the mode
entities.description: The mode, its count, the death cause, the screen and the pause flag (mode, mode_count, death_cause, screen, paused).
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).
entities.result: Names such as title, docked, tunnel_launch, flight, dying, escape.

entities.name: Read the cockpit
entities.description: The player's in-flight state, the timed message, the condition and the countdown.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).

entities.name: Read the pilot
entities.description: Name, cash, fuel, legal standing, rank, kills, missiles, hold, lasers and equipment.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).

entities.name: Read navigation
entities.description: The current and selected systems, the cursor and the system data; the nearest system to a point; the galaxy's systems; the local chart.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).
entities.result: Dictionaries and arrays (navigation, system_data, nearest_system, galaxy_systems, local_chart, local_cursor).

entities.name: Read the market panel
entities.description: The 17 market rows with prices, availability, cargo and the stepper's limits.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).

entities.name: Read the equipment panel
entities.description: The items the current system offers, with their prices.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).

entities.name: Read the bubble
entities.description: Every object in slot order, interpolated by alpha, in Godot metres and axes.
entities.authorization: None: any script in the Godot project may call it; SimHost is a Node class registered by the GDExtension (#[func]).
entities.result: An Array of Dictionaries: kind, position, basis and flags.
